title: Area-weight bound for 1-Lipschitz graphs and closed-to-open parameter ball
statement: Let n ≥ 1, k ∈ ℕ, f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ with |f(v) − f(w)| ≤ |v − w| for all v, w, G : ℝⁿ → [0, ∞] any function and t ∈ ℝ. Then ∫⁻_{B̄ⁿ_t(0)} ofReal(1 + 2ⁿ Σ_{i∈Fin n} |Df(v)e_i|²)·G(v) dv ≤ ofReal(1 + n·2ⁿ)·∫⁻_{B̆ⁿ_t(0)} G(v) dv. Here B̄ⁿ_t(0) = closedBall 0 t and B̆ⁿ_t(0) = ball 0 t (open) in ℝⁿ, dv is Lebesgue measure (volume) on ℝⁿ, Df(v) = fderiv ℝ f v (0 where f is not differentiable), e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1, both sides are lower integrals, and the constant ofReal(1 + n·2ⁿ) multiplies the whole open-ball integral.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (f : Euclid n → Euclid k), (∀ v w, ‖f v - f w‖ ≤ ‖v - w‖) → ∀ (G : Euclid n → ℝ≥0∞) (t : ℝ), (∫⁻ v in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) t, ENNReal.ofReal (1 + 2 ^ n * ∑ i : Fin n, ‖fderiv ℝ f v (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) * G v) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (1 + n * 2 ^ n) * (∫⁻ v in ball (0 : Euclid n) t, G v)
